title: Find the reference angle
text: The angle $$\frac{3\pi}{4}$$ is short of a half-rotation of $$\pi$$ (or $$\frac{4\pi}{4}$$ ). This places the angle in the second quadrant. The distance to the horizontal axis is our reference angle, which is $$\frac{\pi}{4}.$$

title: Determine the sign
text: Tangent is the ratio of the $$y\$\$-coordinate$$ $$(sine)$$ $$to$$ $$the$$ $$x\$\$-coordinate$$ $$(cosine)$$. $$In$$ $$the$$ $$second$$ $$quadrant$$, $$y$$ is positive and $$x$$ is negative. A positive divided by a negative means our tangent value must be negative.

title: Evaluate the special value
text: The tangent of the reference angle $$\frac{\pi}{4}$$ is exactly $$1$$ (since the sine and cosine lengths are equal). Applying the negative sign for the second quadrant gives $$-1.$$
